payments.preparing: We're preparing your seat reservation. This takes a few minutes.
payments.reserveExplainer: We reserve €{{amount}} on your card: your estimated share (€{{share}}), the FLOQQ fee (€{{fee}}) and a buffer in case the meter runs higher. After the ride you only pay your real share - the rest is released.
payments.deadline: Reserve before {{time}}, or your seat will be given up.
payments.opensOn: We'll ask you to reserve €{{amount}} from {{date}}.
payments.noCard: Add a payment method to reserve your seat.
payments.failed: Your card couldn't be reserved. Try again, or replace your card in Profile.
payments.shareIncreased: The group changed, so your share went up. Please reserve the new amount.

payments.webAuth: Your bank needs to verify this reservation. Please finish it in the FLOQQ mobile app.
payments.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.

hold_placed_message: €{{amount}} reserved - you'll only pay your real share after the ride
payer_preview: You'll pay about €{{taxi}} for the taxi and get about €{{back}} back automatically.

payer.title: You're paying the taxi
payer.feeOnly: You get off last, so you pay the taxi at the end. Your seat reservation works like everyone's, but afterwards only the €{{fee}} FLOQQ fee is charged - your own share you pay straight to the taxi.
payer.payoutExplainer: To get the others' shares back, set up your payout with Stripe, our payment partner (about 5 minutes: name, date of birth, address, phone and IBAN). You can also do it after the ride - we'll keep your money until then.
payer.payoutUnfinished: You haven't finished your payout setup yet. You can continue where you left off.
payer.payoutNeedsMore: Stripe needs a bit more information from you before we can send your money.
payer.payoutChecking: Stripe is checking your details. This usually takes a few minutes.
payer.payoutReady: Payout set up ✓ - the others' shares will be sent to your bank after the ride.
payer.someoneElsePays: Another passenger in your group pays the taxi. After the ride only your real share is charged to your card.
payer.cantPay: Can't pay the taxi? Only the last passenger can, so the only way out is to cancel your seat below - then whoever gets off last pays instead.

receipt.title: Taxi receipt
receipt.afterRide: After the ride, photograph the taxi receipt here so we can work out everyone's final share.
receipt.explainer: Take a photo of the receipt the driver gives you. We read the total and the date from it, split the fare by distance just like the estimate, and send the others' shares back to you.
receipt.photoTips: Lay the receipt flat in good light, with the whole receipt in the photo - the total, date and time must be readable.
receipt.covered: The others' seat reservations cover their shares - you get everything back.
receipt.guaranteeUsed: The fare came out higher than the others' seat reservations cover (€{{holds}} reserved in total). FLOQQ pays the missing €{{amount}} under the Ride Payment Guarantee - you still get everything back.
receipt.inReview: FLOQQ is checking this receipt by hand. You'll get the others' shares once it's approved - usually within a day.
receipt.wrongPhotoHint: Photographed the wrong receipt, or was it read wrongly? Take a new photo of the receipt from this ride.
receipt.rejected: This receipt was not accepted. Please photograph the receipt from this ride.
receipt.rejectedWithNote: This receipt was not accepted: {{note}}. Please photograph the receipt from this ride.
receipt.unreadable: We couldn't read the receipt. Lay it flat in good light and make sure the whole receipt is in the photo.
receipt.notATaxiReceipt: That doesn't look like a taxi receipt. Please photograph the receipt the driver printed for this ride.
receipt.noTotal: We couldn't read the total on the receipt. Take the photo again, closer and in good light.
receipt.tooEarly: The ride hasn't started yet - you can photograph the receipt once it has.
receipt.locked: The receipt for this ride has already been accepted. Contact FLOQQ if something is wrong.
receipt.tooManyAttempts: Too many photos for this ride. FLOQQ will contact you to sort out the receipt.
receipt.scanFailed: We couldn't check the receipt right now. Please try again in a minute.
receipt.photoFailed: The photo couldn't be uploaded. Please try again.
receipt.cameraDenied: FLOQQ needs camera access to photograph the receipt. Allow it in your phone settings.
receipt.invalidTotal: Enter the amount in euros, e.g. 38.50 (at most €500).
receipt.deadline: Photograph the receipt before {{time}}. After that everyone pays the estimated fare and FLOQQ checks your refund by hand.
receipt.estimated: No receipt came in on time, so everyone pays the estimated fare of €{{total}}.
receipt.estimatedReplace: Still have the receipt? Photograph it now and it replaces the estimate.

settlement.payerPaid: {{taxi}} €{{total}} - you paid the taxi - €{{fee}} FLOQQ fee paid. €{{released}} released.
settlement.chargeAt: {{taxi}} €{{total}} - your share €{{share}} + €{{fee}} FLOQQ fee will be charged at {{time}}. The rest of your reservation is then released.
settlement.payerChargeAt: {{taxi}} €{{total}} - you paid the taxi, so only the €{{fee}} FLOQQ fee is charged, at {{time}}. The rest of your reservation is then released.
settlement.captureFailed: We couldn't charge your card for this ride. FLOQQ will contact you.
settlement.payoutAt: The others are charged at {{time}}. Then €{{amount}} is sent to you.
settlement.payoutWaiting: €{{amount}} is waiting for you - finish your payout setup above and we'll send it.
settlement.cancelWhileSettling: Your ride is being paid right now. You can close it once that's done - usually within a few hours.
settlement.outstanding: We couldn’t charge €{{amount}} for this ride - your reservation had already ended. FLOQQ will contact you.
settlement.payoutHeld: FLOQQ checks the ride before sending you €{{amount}}, because there was no receipt.
